#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

long double c[21][21], coef[21], sum_mask[1 << 20], p[20];
int sz_mask[1 << 20];

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &k);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        double x;
        scanf("%lf", &x);
        p[i] = x;
    }
    c[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        c[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) c[i][j] = c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j];
    }
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
        sz_mask[mask] = 0;
        sum_mask[mask] = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (((mask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                sz_mask[mask]++;
                sum_mask[mask] += p[j];
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        coef[i] = 1 - coef[i];
        for (int j = 1; i - j >= 0; j++) {
            coef[i - j] += c[n - 1 - i + j][j] * coef[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        long double answer = 0.0;
        if (p[i] > 0.005) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                if (sz_mask[mask] >= k) continue;
                answer += coef[sz_mask[mask]] / (1 - sum_mask[mask]);
            }
        }
        printf("%.12lf ", (double)(p[i] * answer));
    }
    printf("\n");
    return 0;
}
